name: MedHealth AI
description: AI-powered clinical decision support platform helping hospitals reduce diagnostic errors and streamline patient triage.
productDescription: A HIPAA-compliant clinical decision support suite that ingests EHR data and lab results to surface diagnostic suggestions, flag drug interactions, and prioritize patient triage for emergency departments.
businessGoals: Expand into 15 private hospital groups across the GCC and secure 3 government healthcare pilots within 12 months.
additionalInfo: Recently completed a Series A round. Strong regulatory relationships in the UAE. Looking to position around measurable clinical outcomes.

name: FleetCore Logistics
description: Real-time fleet optimization software that cuts fuel costs and improves on-time delivery for mid-market logistics providers.
productDescription: A route optimization and telematics platform combining live traffic, weather, and vehicle-health data to automatically re-route fleets and predict maintenance windows.
businessGoals: Grow ARR from EUR 4M to EUR 10M by landing enterprise 3PL accounts and expanding into the Nordics.
additionalInfo: Sales cycle averages 90 days. Main competitors are legacy on-prem TMS vendors. Sustainability angle resonates with EU buyers.

name: Lumen Fintech
description: Embedded finance API that lets SaaS platforms offer instant working-capital loans to their SMB customers.
productDescription: A white-label lending-as-a-service API with automated underwriting, KYC/AML, and disbursement rails that platforms embed directly into their checkout and dashboards.
businessGoals: Sign 5 platform partners with 10k+ SMBs each and reach USD 50M in originated loan volume this fiscal year.
additionalInfo: Regulatory licenses secured in Singapore. Needs messaging that reassures compliance-conscious platform CTOs and CFOs.
